# MyHealthOpinions – Caregiver Profiles

> MyHealthOpinions runs a paid market-research panel. This site is the profile area for **caregivers**: people who look after a family member, a friend or clients (paid or unpaid). Caregivers complete short profiles so they can be matched with relevant healthcare surveys and earn rewards. The site is available in 12 languages.

The site is a single-page web app. Respondents have already given consent when they joined the panel, so the profile pages contain no consent forms and no captcha.

## What a visitor can do

- Choose one of 12 languages: English, 中文 (Chinese), Español, हिन्दी (Hindi), العربية (Arabic), Français, Deutsch, Português, 日本語 (Japanese), 한국어 (Korean), Русский (Russian), Italiano. A link can force a language with `?lang=xx`, for example `?lang=zh`.
- Switch between light and dark theme and turn sound effects on or off.
- Complete 12 caregiver profiles, which show up in separate "To complete", "Continue" and "Completed" sections. Answers can be edited after a profile is completed.
- Open a profile directly with `#profile=<id>`.

## Rewards

- Every completed profile earns **100 Care Points** (awarded once; editing a profile does not add points). **1,000 points = 1 USD**, so all 12 profiles = 1,200 points = $1.20.
- The section lives in the "My Profile" tab of the MyHealthOpinions caregiver dashboard. About You profiles come first; caregiver surveys stay sealed until every profile is complete and then open one at a time.
- Every completed profile or survey earns 50 Care Points and 1 Quality Score, shown in the "Circle of Care" ([#rewards](https://caregivers.myhealthopinions.com/#rewards)): a glass heart that fills as the Quality Score grows, surrounded by one glowing bead per completed item, with care levels from Newcomer to Luminary.
- Caregivers with unfinished items receive a reminder e-mail every 2 days ("Your Circle of Care is waiting") listing only what is still open, until they finish or unsubscribe.

## Profiles

- [Your Caregiving Role](https://caregivers.myhealthopinions.com/#profile=care-role): whether and how the person provides care (unpaid, paid or both)
- [Basic Profile](https://caregivers.myhealthopinions.com/#profile=basic): name, date of birth, email, country, region, city, postcode, area type, income, family
- [Education & Care Skills](https://caregivers.myhealthopinions.com/#profile=education): education, nursing qualifications, certifications, care responsibilities
- [Professional Profile](https://caregivers.myhealthopinions.com/#profile=professional): caregiving job role (20 roles), setting, experience, employment
- [Personal Health](https://caregivers.myhealthopinions.com/#profile=health): check-ups, vaccinations, insurance, allergies
- [Health Insurance](https://caregivers.myhealthopinions.com/#profile=insurance): own cover and cover managed for the care recipient
- [Food & Lifestyle](https://caregivers.myhealthopinions.com/#profile=food): grocery, beverage, tobacco and wellness purchasing
- [Sports & Fitness](https://caregivers.myhealthopinions.com/#profile=fitness): exercise, sports, sleep, fitness technology
- [Technology & Digital Health](https://caregivers.myhealthopinions.com/#profile=tech): devices, health apps, digital health services
- [Survey & Reward Preferences](https://caregivers.myhealthopinions.com/#profile=survey): survey history, preferred modes, time and rewards
- [Social Media & Payouts](https://caregivers.myhealthopinions.com/#profile=social): optional social handles and payout method
- [Additional Details](https://caregivers.myhealthopinions.com/#profile=additional): languages, household, caregiving hours and challenges, a short self-description
